C1453.title: Ethereum Community Discussion on Whether Timestamp Manipulation Is Still Possible and How Users Can Detect It
C1453.summary: A question posted on Ethereum StackExchange asks whether timestamp manipulation attacks remain feasible under the current Ethereum network conditions and, if so, whether users can detect and avoid such attacks.
